'''Tim Guzman Tustin Tournament Report (tournament report)''' is [[Tim Guzman]]'s report on [[Tustin tournament (The Outer Rim)]]. He published it on [[The Outer Rim (fan site)|The Outer Rim]] as The Information Broker.<ref name="or-tustin">[https://www.geocities.ws/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/Articles/Tustinreport.htm Tustin Tournament Report], The Outer Rim (The Information Broker). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261029234542/https://www.geocities.ws/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/Articles/Tustinreport.htm Internet Archive]</ref> He finished 15th of 85 at 10 (+88) with [[ISB Operations / Empires New Order|ISB]] and New School Mains and Toys. [[Eric Bruen]] won.

== Report info ==
* '''Author:''' [[Tim Guzman]] (byline: The Information Broker)

* '''Players:''' 85
* '''Finish:''' 15th
* '''Record:''' 10 (+88) over 8 games
* '''Dark deck:''' [[ISB Operations / Empires New Order|ISB]] with Outer Rim Scouts
* '''Light deck:''' New School Mains and Toys

== Original report ==

<blockquote>
<div style="white-space:pre-wrap; font-family:inherit"><nowiki>
Title: TUSTIN TOURNAMENT REPORT

 Well here is the tournament report
 I promised. There was 7 of us here from Las Vegas who went down to Tustin to
 play in this Tournament. It was a huge turn out. There was 84 people who show
 up and the 85th person came during the first game. I will give this report through
 my eyes, and through what happen during my games. For my light side I played
 NEW school Mains and Toys. My dark side I played ISB with a lot of ORS.

 Those of us that came were Chris Hines, Brad Bedlion, Preston Pendergraft, Kris
 Lavigne, Dan Christy, John Spadora, and myself(Tim Guzman). When we got there
 it was kind of raining, but the sun came out soon enough. I felt good and was
 ready for the competition. There was a lot of High ranking people there. After
 all first place prize was well worth it. In fact 5 out of 8 people I faced had
 1750 rating or above. Well here is what you are waiting for so I will get to
 it.

 Game 1: My ISB vs Some Kids first Tournement 'We called him DONKEY' his rating:1500

 Well I had a horrible draw during this game. But that didn't matter because
 this poor kid didn't make any good decisions. His starting location was Yavin
 4:Docking Bay, so that only told me this is going to be easy. He had maybe only
 4 rares in his whole deck. I even was nice enough to remind him of his characters
 game text. Anyway full win by +33

 2(+33)

 Highlights: Well not much except I won by 33 even with a bad draw.

 Lowlights: His voice was ear piercing.

 Game 2: My New School MnT vs Dark Side Musicians(I don't know this guys name,
 so sorry)his rating:1650ish

 I had a good draw in this game. I put down the farm with Ben and a monk on second
 turn. Yoda is at his hut so I feel confident. The only thing he did for his
 first 5 turns was take my drains and Draw. Then I drew Grimtaash and he had
 like 20 cards in hand so I felt good about using it. When I did I saw then that
 he was playing musicians, and out of all those cards I only got one dupe. I
 looked down and noticed how much he was going to activate and thought to myself
 that this is not good. Ben was at the farm and I couldn't move him because of
 lack of force. Melas and a Monk and Twass was in the AC and I new they were
 going to get hit. Sure enough his turn he Deploys Jabba then Greeta, then Lyn
 Me, then Fett for free, and all other musicians he had in his hand. It was ugly,
 with Lyn Me text my power was reduced to zero. I lost all cards at that site
 plus 18 force. Hence I lost that game. Full Lost -13

 2(+20)

 Highlights:I was taught to never play without Houjix.

 Lowlights:I made a mistake to play grimtaash. If I saved my force I could have
 move Ben for more Back up.

 Game 3: My ISB vs John Spadora's Light side Mains his Rating:1600ish

 Well I did not want to play someone I came with, but it happens. My starting
 Draw was not that bad. I had control most of the game. Flipped ISB soon. But
 He managed to Flip it back. A battle againts Han is what I think lost the game
 for him. Full Win +30ish(I can't Remember)

 4(+50ish)

 Highlights:Deploying a ISB and Vader to Light side War Room and Battling and
 Drawing two 5's.

 Lowlights: Playing someone I came with.

 Game 4: My LightSide vs Josh's Hunt down Deck, his Rating:1750

 Wow I had a Great Draw. Ben and his stick and a revolution. First Turn I deploy
 Leia with weapon to his Third Marker. His Turn he uses all his force to Deploy
 DLOTS with Saber. It took a lot of force since I start with Goo Nee Tay. My
 Turn I nabrien Leia to Holotheatre. Cancel Visage and Force drain there. Then
 use Revolution on Med. Chamber. His turn he Elis vader where leia is, I Quite
 a Mercenary. Basically I had Control of this game. Full Win +32

 6(+80ish)

 Highlignts: It was a fast game, afterwards I had a chance to use the restroom.
 This is something you did not need to know.

 Lowlights: It was a fast game, I had to wait a while until I played again.

 Game 5: My ISB vs Kris Lavign's Sabacc his Rating:1775

 Well what is up with this I had to play yet another person I brought to the
 Tournament. Well I had a decent draw. I don't think he did through. I kind of
 know his deck a little, so I start with Secret Plans. He was not playing sabacc
 like a true gambler because I think he lost most of those. DLOTS was in control
 most of the game. When I grab Sabacc with "Hell to Pay" that ended that. Full
 Win +30ish?

 8(+110)I remember my total at this point

 Highlights: Lunch was after this game. Not that there was much food left.

 Lowlights: Once Again playing someone I know with my best deck.

 Game 6: My Light MnT vs Kevin Shannon's ISB ORS deck almost like mine. His Rating:1800ish

 When I saw ORS I thought this is going to be tough. I was right. Obi-Wan and
 his stick missed a swing twice when Targeting. And that is how the game went
 I had bad draws most of the game. I did a late come back but it was too late
 by then. Full Loss -15

 8(+95)

 Highlights:Lossing to a deck I respect.

 Lowlights: Not Preparing for a deck I should know quite well.

 Game 7:My light MnT's vs Matt's Old School Mains SAC deck. His Rating:2071

 He came all the way from Connecticut so here is a loyal player. I had a good
 draw. He starts with Jabba Palace's. On his first turn I get to verify his deck
 because the AC was not there. He then deploy the Ice Plains. My first turn I
 revolution the Ice Plains to begin my Choking. He gets vader out, but doesn't
 last long. I deploy Oola to cause even more headaches for him. Things were just
 not looking good for him. On one turn when I didn't Oola he Deploys Vader for
 11 Force, two from Goo Nee Tay, one from Restriced Deployment and two from H'nemth.
 He battles and draw a one(which is a two with Darth Vader). My Characters all
 immune because Yoda is at his Hut. It was a Fun Game, for me anyway. Full Win
 +21

 10(+116)

 Highlights: Winning a Game againts someone with a Huge Rating. And watching
 all his SAC not Work.

 Lowlights:Not any during this game.

 Game 8: My ISB vs James Lafferty's Hidden Base x-wing Swarm his Rating:1970ish

 Well this was the last game I had to win this one. My ISB Deck was undefeated
 since I built the deck so I was confident. Things were kind of even for a while.
 But I could not probe his system for the life of me. He had 8 system out and
 I Probe seven of them. Guess what, his Hidden base was the one I didn't Probe.
 My ship died a horrible death to the x-wings. He retrieve with 'All Wings'.
 Then after that he convert his x-wings with x-wings squadrons, to put even more
 cards in his used pile. I can still here his answer to my force drains:"Cancel,
 Cancel, It's A hit, It Could be Worse, and Rebel Fleet." That Sucked. Full Loss
 -28

 ENDED TOURNAMENT AT 10(+88)

 Highlights: Nothing.....

 Lowlights:There was a lot during this game....I still can't believe that I didn't
 Probe the base.

 Well We all had Fun. If I won that Last game by only one card I would have came
 in 6th, If I won that game by only 24 I would have came in 3rd. But as it was
 I came in 15th Place out of 85 people so I have to be happy with that. I will
 be looking forward to big ones like this soon.

 Here is how Las Vegas Players did to the best of my Memory:

 Tim Guzman 10(+88)

 Brad Bedlion 10(+47)?

 Chris Hines 8(+50ish)?

 Kris Lavigne 8(+ISH)?

 Preston Pendgraft...I don't remember I just know you were above the ones below.

 Dan Christy 6(??)

 John Spadora 6(??)

 The Winner of the Tournament was Named Eric Bruen.

 The Information Broker
</nowiki></div>
</blockquote>
